obligations: Copy and distribute the Quran text verbatim only; changing the text is not allowed.

Reproduce the Tanzil copyright notice in all verbatim copies of the text and in all files derived from or containing a substantial portion of it (shipped as TANZIL-NOTICE.txt).

qf-developer-terms.name: Quran Foundation Content API Developer Terms
obligations: Display may be used in commercial, freemium and ad-supported apps, but QF content and raw API data may not be sold, sublicensed or redistributed.
Do not cache or store QF content longer than 1 week except through the Content Sync APIs, which require a re-sync at least every 7 days.
Never call the OAuth2 token endpoint from browser/mobile code and never ship the client_secret; use a server-side token broker (Server-Only Rule).
Credit Quran Foundation and each edition/reciter by name.
